posts.cooked:
So, I asked the GTG guys at PAX Aus (just this weekend passed) "Who would you get to play Baron Blade in a SOTM movie?", and they suggested I ask here on the forums.

So I'm expanding the question.

Which actors/actresses would you cast to play various characters in a SOTM movie?

Now, I'm going to seperate this into two answers:

Current Day Casting - i.e. actors/actresses who are alive and current today.

Dream Casting - i.e. any actor/actress from any era/history.

I've been thinking about this but really haven't a clue, so just seeing what the SOTM ciommunity out there thinks.

posts.name: jffdougan
posts.cooked:
Without looking at the other thread, my immediate thoughts are:

  • Absolute Zero - John Cusack
  • Argent Adept - one of the Phelps twins
  • Beacon - overdone maybe, but Hayden Panietierre
  • Bunker - Mark Wahlberg
  • Captain Cosmic
  • Chrono-Ranger - Clint Eastwood, duh
  • Expatriette - Angie Harmon
  • Fanatic - Kristin Stewart, believe it or not
  • Guise - Matt Bomer
  • Haka - Lawrence Makoare
  • KNYFE -Miranda Otto
  • Legacy - Jeremy Renner
  • Mr. Fixer - Djimon Hounsou
  • Naturalist - Idris Elba. Failing that, Aldis Hodge
  • Nightmist - Sandra Bullock
  • Omnitron-X - voice by Brian Blessed
  • Parse - Frema Agyamen
  • Ra - Ioan Gryffydd
  • The Scholar - Jeff Bridges, of course
  • The Sentinels - Dr. Medico = Matthew Lewis, Idealist = Christina Ricci c. 1992,  Mainstay = Vin Diesel, Writhe = Tony Shalhoub
  • Setback - Anton Yelchin (aka Odd Thomas)
  • Tachyon - Emily Bett Rickards
  • Tempest - Noah Wyle
  • Unity - Alexandra Daddario
  • Visionary - Karen Gillan
  • Wraith - Gina Bellman

 

Villains:

  • Akash'bhuta - voice by Tilda Swinton
  • Ambuscade - Vincent Cassel
  • Apostate - John Barrowman
  • Baron Blade - David Tennant
  • Chairman Pike & the Operative
  • Citizen Dawn - Kate Beckinsale
  • Dreamer - Elle Fanning c. 2005
  • Ennead (skipping this one, as I don't want to make THAT many decisions)
  • Ermine - Beth Riesgraf
  • Friction - Joanne Kelly
  • Fright Train - your choice of pro wrestler-turned-actor
  • Gloomweaver - Malik Yoba. Failing that, Sharif Atkins
  • Iron Legacy - Jeremy Renner, in keeping with the above
  • Kismet - Azita Ghanizada
  • La Capitan Maria Helena... - Anne Hathaway
  • Matriarch - Emma Watson
  • Miss Information/Aminia Twain
  • Omnitron-I/II/V - voice by Brendan Fraser
  • Plague Rat - Brad Pitt
  • Proletariat - Sebastian Stan
  • Spite - Simon Vance
  • Voss - probably overdone, but Benedict Cumberbatch

I reserve the right to come back in and edit this as I remember the names that go with some of the faces I can see in my head or to correct spelling.

 

Updated filling in some of the gaps.

posts.cooked:
I keep going thinking about these. I still need:

  • Argent Adept
  • Dr. Medico
  • Writhe
  • Tempest
  • the various members of the Ennead
  • Proletariat
  • The Wrath of the Cosmos-related characters

 

On some consideration, I think I'd put Matthew Lewis in as Dr. Medico, and one of the Phelps twins (Fred & George Weasley from the Harry Potter films) in as the Argent Adept since I can't quickly think of any red-headed male actors & am trying to not have to do wig/makeup jobs except where required.

Tempest and Writhe feel older-ish to me -- i.e., closer to my age than to the ages of a lot of the actors already mentioned, who are in their late 20s and early 30s. Maybe take Noah Wyle and Tony Shalhoub, respectively?

Splicing these into my original post, and updating one other.
